en.title: Pipe Installer – Pingtung (2 people)
description: Pipe installation, site repair work, plumbing and electrical systems, mechanical and electrical work, and fire protection systems.
Industrial painting and repair of factory equipment. Work is done both in the workshop and on construction sites.
requirements: Has been to Taiwan before.
No restrictions on education level or marital status.
Experience in pipe installation, water supply and drainage, or welding is preferred.
No alcohol while working.
benefits: 1 meal provided. Meals provided for overtime from the 3rd hour onward.
Workers pay their own dormitory fees.

zh.title: 屏東管線安裝工（2人）
description: 管線施工、工程修繕、水電、機電及消防系統施工。
工業噴漆及廠房設備維修。工作地點包括廠內及工地。
requirements: 曾來過臺灣。
學歷及婚姻狀況不限。
具管線施工、給排水或焊接經驗者優先。
上班期間不得飲酒。
benefits: 提供1餐。加班第3小時起提供餐點。
勞工自付宿舍費用。

en.title: Excavator Operator & Site Laborer – Pingtung (3 people)
description: 1 excavator or construction machine operator: operate excavators and equipment and coordinate work on site.
2 general site workers: assist with on-site work.
requirements: Under 40 years old.
No restrictions on education level or marital status.
The operator position requires at least 2 years of experience.
benefits: 1 meal provided on work days.
Workers pay their own dormitory fees.
Overtime varies depending on the project schedule.

zh.title: 屏東怪手操作員及工地雜工（3人）
description: 怪手或施工機械操作員1名：操作怪手及設備，並配合工地現場作業。
工地雜工2名：協助現場工作。
requirements: 40歲以下。
學歷及婚姻狀況不限。
操作員職位須具2年以上經驗。
benefits: 上班日提供1餐。
勞工自付宿舍費用。
加班視工程各階段而定。

en.title: Plumbing/Electrical & A/C Installer – Taipei, New Taipei (2 male)
description: Installation and repair of air conditioning systems.
Plumbing and electrical piping work. Arc welding skills preferred.
requirements: Vietnamese male, aged 25–40.
Studied mechanical and electrical engineering, electrical technology, or a related field.
Able to drive and holds a driver's license.
No restrictions on marital status.
benefits: About 40 hours of overtime per month under Taiwan's Labor Standards Act.
Work hours 08:00–17:30 with a 1.5-hour lunch break, 6 days off per month.
Housing and 1 meal provided, with no deduction for room and board. Utility bills are shared equally.
Bonuses or gifts for the three major holidays.

zh.title: 臺北、新北水電冷氣安裝工程師（男2名）
description: 冷氣空調的安裝與維修。
水電管線施工。會電焊者優先。
requirements: 越南籍男性，25至40歲。
機電、電機或相關科系畢業。
會開車且持有駕照。
婚姻狀況不限。
benefits: 依臺灣勞動基準法，每月加班約40小時。
上班時間08:00至17:30，午休1小時30分鐘，每月休6天。
提供住宿及1餐，不扣伙食及住宿費。水電費均攤。
三節提供獎金或禮品。

en.title: Mechanical Plant Technician – New Taipei (1 male)
description: Operate lathes, perform arc welding, and assemble and repair precision machinery, metal components, and heavy construction machinery.
Some tasks require physical strength.
requirements: Vietnamese male, aged 25–40.
Graduate in mechanical engineering or a related field.
Basic Chinese and prior work experience in Taiwan preferred.
No restrictions on marital status.
benefits: About 45 hours of overtime per month. Work Monday to Saturday, 08:00–12:00 and 13:00–17:00.
1 meal provided.
Those who find their own housing receive a NT$3,000/month allowance; those in company-arranged housing have NT$3,000/month deducted.

zh.title: 新北機械廠技術人員（男1名）
description: 操作車床、電焊，組裝及維修精密機械、五金零件及營造用重型機械。
部分工作需要體力。
requirements: 越南籍男性，25至40歲。
機械或相關科系畢業。
具基礎中文及曾在臺灣工作經驗者優先。
婚姻狀況不限。
benefits: 提供1餐。
自行找住宿者每月補助新台幣3,000元；住公司安排的住宿則每月扣新台幣3,000元。

en.title: M&E and Industrial A/C Technician – Hsinchu (3 people)
description: Plumbing and electrical construction on site.
Repair and maintenance of high-capacity air conditioning systems and related mechanical and electrical work.
requirements: Vietnamese nationals able to communicate in Chinese.
Experience in plumbing and electrical work, construction mechanical and electrical work, or industrial A/C repair preferred.
Good health, hardworking, and able to work on construction sites.
benefits: 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday. Work beyond 8 hours and on Saturdays and Sundays counts as overtime.
Lunch provided on work days.
Workers pay their own dormitory fees.

zh.title: 新竹機電、工業冷氣技術人員（3人）
description: 工地水電施工。
大型空調系統的維修保養及相關機電工作。
requirements: 越南籍勞工，能以中文溝通。
具水電、工程機電或工業冷氣維修經驗者優先。
身體健康、勤奮，能在工地工作。
benefits: 每日工作8小時，週一至週五。超過8小時及週六、週日工作計為加班。
上班日提供午餐。
勞工自付宿舍費用。

en.title: Anti-Vibration Steel Structure Technician – Tainan (4 male)
description: Manage subcontractors and coordinate on-site work.
Supervise construction progress and quality.
Provide technical support and on-site inspection in cleanrooms.
requirements: Male aged 23–40, college diploma or above (science or engineering majors preferred).
Basic conversational Chinese.
No color blindness, good health.
No experience required; training provided.
benefits: About 46 hours of overtime per month as permitted by law.
Workers cover their own room and board.
Base salary paid on the 1st; other payments on the 10th.

zh.title: 臺南防震鋼構生產技術人員（男4名）
description: 管理協力廠商，協調現場作業。
監督施工進度與品質。
在無塵室內提供技術支援及現場檢查。
requirements: 男性，23至40歲，專科以上學歷（理工科系優先）。
具基本中文會話能力。
無色盲，身體健康。
無需經驗，提供培訓。
benefits: 依法每月加班約46小時。
食宿自理。
底薪於每月1日發放，其他款項於每月10日發放。

en.title: Mechanical & Electrical, Plumbing Technician – Tainan (5 male)
description: Mechanical and electrical construction, plumbing and electrical installation.
requirements: Male aged 23–40, at least 1.60 m tall, vocational school graduate or above.
Basic relevant experience. Chinese language skills preferred.
Quick and able to coordinate well with others.
benefits: Steady overtime of 40–50 hours per month.
NT$2,500/month deducted for room and board; employer provides lunch.
3-year contract, renewable.

zh.title: 臺南工程機電、水電技術人員（男5名）
description: 機電施工、水電安裝。
requirements: 男性，23至40歲，身高160公分以上，高職以上畢業。
具相關基礎經驗。會中文者優先。
反應靈活，能良好配合團隊作業。
benefits: 每月穩定加班40至50小時。
每月扣新台幣2,500元食宿費，雇主提供午餐。
合約3年，可續約。

en.title: Welder & Steel Structure Installer – Kaohsiung (10 male)
description: Grinding, manual arc welding, CO₂ welding, and assembly and installation of steel structures, including work at height.
requirements: Male, at least 1.60 m tall, vocational school graduate or above.
Experience in machinery, steel, or welding. Knowledge of 6G welding and CO₂ welding preferred.
Able to work at height.
benefits: Employer provides lunch, overtime meals, and housing assistance.
3-year contract.

zh.title: 高雄焊接、鋼構安裝人員（男10名）
description: 研磨、手工電焊、CO₂焊接、鋼構組裝與安裝，包含高空作業。
requirements: 男性，身高160公分以上，高職以上畢業。
具機械、鋼鐵或焊接經驗。會6G焊接及CO₂焊接者優先。
能從事高空作業。
benefits: 雇主提供午餐、加班餐及住宿補助。
合約3年。

en.title: Electrical Installer – Electronics & Semiconductor Plants, Taiwan
description: Install equipment and electrical systems and run electrical wiring in electronics factories.
Work in cleanrooms with a stable temperature of about 25°C.
Hiring entities: contractors for high-tech factory construction projects.
requirements: Male or female under 40; female applicants need good conversational Chinese.
Vocational school graduate or above, engineering majors preferred.
Application method: submit documents through a form, interview via LINE.
benefits: Take-home pay of about NT$40,000–60,000/month depending on overtime at different times.
Benefits and policies according to company regulations.
Work environment inside the factory.

zh.title: 臺灣電子、半導體廠房電氣施工工程師（100人）
zh.location: 臺灣各地（電子、半導體廠房）
description: 在電子廠內安裝設備及電氣系統、配置電線。
於無塵室工作，溫度穩定約25°C。
招募單位：高科技廠房工程的施工承包商。
requirements: 男女皆可，40歲以下；女性須具良好中文會話能力。
高職以上畢業，理工科系優先。
應徵方式：透過表單提交資料，以LINE面試。
benefits: 實領薪資約每月新台幣40,000至60,000元，依各時期加班情況而定。
制度與福利依公司規定。
廠內工作環境。

en.title: Machine Installer, M&E, Cleanroom – Miaoli (20 male)
description: Installation of mechanical and electrical systems, air conditioning, and cleanrooms.
Work inside the plants of electronics and semiconductor factories.
requirements: Male aged 23–45, at least 1.60 m tall, with qualifications sufficient to process an engineer visa.
Good health and hardworking.
Experience in machinery or machine installation preferred. Ability to read drawings is an advantage.
benefits: About 30–50 hours of overtime per month.
Workers cover their own room and board. 3-year contract.

zh.title: 苗栗機台安裝、機電、無塵室工程師（男20名）
description: 機電系統、空調及無塵室的施工安裝。
於電子、半導體廠房內工作。
requirements: 男性，23至45歲，身高160公分以上，學歷條件符合辦理工程師簽證。
身體健康、勤奮。
具機械、機台安裝經驗者優先。看得懂圖面者佳。
benefits: 每月加班約30至50小時。
食宿自付。合約3年。

en.title: Forklift Repair & Maintenance Technician – Kaohsiung (2 male)
description: Forklift repair, welding, oxy-fuel cutting, and related mechanical work.
requirements: Basic Chinese, or a commitment to learn it while the application is being processed.
Good health, hardworking, and a good team player.
Experience in machinery, welding, or forklift repair preferred.
benefits: Overtime depends on work needs.
Company provides dormitory and lunch. Workers pay their own utilities, breakfast, and dinner.
3-year contract.

zh.title: 高雄堆高機維修保養技術人員（男2名）
description: 堆高機維修、焊接、氧氣切割及相關機械工作。
requirements: 具基礎中文，或承諾在辦理文件期間自行學習。
身體健康、勤奮，能配合團隊作業。
具機械、焊接或堆高機維修經驗者優先。
benefits: 加班視工作需求而定。
公司提供宿舍及午餐。勞工自付水電費、早餐及晚餐。
合約3年。

en.title: Paper Coating Machine Operator – Taichung (2–3 male)
description: Operate paper coating machines.
Inspect and arrange goods and clean the work area.
Work is indoors in the workshop, not outdoors.
requirements: Male aged 23–45, at least 1.60 m tall.
Good health, willing to work rotating shifts, good conversational Chinese.
Experience in machine operation or factory work preferred.
benefits: No overtime at present. Taxes and insurance according to Taiwan regulations.
Company provides 1 meal. Housing is off-site; workers pay their own rent.
3-year contract.

zh.title: 臺中紙品塗佈機操作員（男2至3名）
description: 操作紙品塗佈機。
檢查、整理貨品並清潔工作區域。
在廠內作業，無需戶外工作。
requirements: 男性，23至45歲，身高160公分以上。
身體健康，可接受輪班，具良好中文會話能力。
具機台操作或工廠工作經驗者優先。
benefits: 目前無加班。稅金及保險依臺灣規定。
公司提供1餐。住宿在外，勞工自付租金。
合約3年。
